statement: SDL's periodic Wii MotionPlus check probes standard extension and then A600FE identification asynchronously. It can schedule a joystick disconnect/reinitialization when MotionPlus presence differs from the cached presence, but does not update m_ucMotionPlusMode in the response handler when an already-known MotionPlus changes from inactive to active. If present remains true while cached mode stays NONE, repeating the periodic check alone does not recover gyro decoding. Reopening a fresh SDL device after kernel activation is a distinct test.

applicability.revision: SDL 3.2.10, SDL 3.4.18 and SDL main at pinned October 2026 source commits; no retail Wii measurement
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. NeedsPeriodicMotionPlusCheck 430-443; CheckMotionPlusConnection 450-455; HandleResponse 1396-1435; UpdateDevice 1546-1559. No run proves a reconnect succeeds.
